name: model-companions-kimi-workspace
description: Marketplace and workspace for the Kimi Code Claude Code plugin.

scripts.test: npm run test:kimi && node --test tests/documentation.test.mjs tests/marketplace.test.mjs tests/structured-output.test.mjs tests/release-tools.test.mjs
scripts.validate: claude plugin validate --strict . && npm run validate --workspaces --if-present
scripts.validate:kimi: npm run version:check:kimi && claude plugin validate --strict . && npm --prefix plugins/kimi run validate
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run version:check && npm run test:pack
scripts.release:check:strict: npm run release:check && npm run validate
